title.zh: 情态动词：想、能、可以、必须
title.en: Modal verbs: want, can, may, must

body_zh: wil（想）、kan（能）、mag（可以、允许）、moet（必须）这类词放在普通动词的位置，后面的动作动词用原形。
在短句里，动作动词通常放到句末：Ik wil een taal leren.
问句把变位的情态动词放到前面：Kan jij vandaag werken?
body_en: Words such as wil (want), kan (can), mag (may, be allowed to) and moet (must) take the usual verb position; the action verb stays in the infinitive.
In a short sentence, the action verb usually goes at the end: Ik wil een taal leren.
In a question, move the conjugated modal verb to the front: Kan jij vandaag werken?

examples.en: I want to learn a language.
